summary: Four surfaces across three repos, one commit each: ArgoCDTools/README.md is the new repo's manual (the four-argument contract and what a run does in order, the environment it reads and the two out-of-pod knobs, what the image carries and why each item is there, the CI tag pair, what each gate proves, and a 'not wired yet' section naming what is still owed — the hand-created IaC/ArgoCDTools job, the PAT, the standup's namespace/SA/ExternalSecret); Ansible CLAUDE.md's related-repos list gained ArgoCDTools, and docs/runbooks/iac-agent.md's TerraformState row now says the state repo is not srviac's alone (the hook writes argocd/<repo>/<stage>/ keys with the one age keypair at kv/iac/tf-backend, which the prd eso AppRole is granted read on rather than a copy being made); AnsibleSpecs/decisions.md's 'what does not get its own AppRole' bullet now carries the rule this slice settled — an in-cluster workload takes OpenBao material as an ESO-materialised Secret, leaf by enumerated leaf, never its own AppRole — which until now lived only in the migration's register, and argo-cd/design.md's flow step 4 states how the kubernetes provider is credentialed (the kubeconfig synthesised from the pod's ServiceAccount, exported as KUBE_CONFIG_PATH and KUBECONFIG, which is what lets a deploy repo keep HelmCharts' bare provider block verbatim — the fact Phase B lifts against). No change to /work/Charts: P5 fixed the README's version pin and the template's doc comment already states the fourth argument. Gates: kc project lint green in /work/Ansible (root skipped, ansible yamllint+ansible-lint OK, terraform fmt OK) and kc project test --project root ('no test statements — skipped'); kc project lint and test green in /work/ArgoCDTools (README is excluded from the image context by .dockerignore's *.md, so the kaniko build is untouched); AnsibleSpecs has no tooling, verified by reading the diff — no added non-table line past 100 columns. Architecture nudge: this repo's producer sees no change — no managed host, daemon or external identity moved, and the only Ansible-side edit is one KV path added to the existing prd eso AppRole's policy — but the estate gained a component the federated model may want an entry for: the ArgoCDTools repo, the registry:5000/argocd-hook image and the IaC/ArgoCDTools Jenkins job, plus a second writer to pvginkel/TerraformState. Handoff: the doc commits in /work/ArgoCDTools (a565d8e) and /work/AnsibleSpecs (27ae4e0) are local and unpushed.
cards: argo-cd/phases.md has no done-marking convention: every item in A.1 (shipped as slice 006) and A.2 (shipped as slice 007) still reads '- [ ]', so the set read on its own presents shipped work as pending. The doc phase did not invent one — no '[x]' exists anywhere in the file, and status is tracked in slices/README.md and on the board. Worth an operator ruling on whether phases.md should carry a shipped marker (and, if so, how it handles items like A.2's 'CI publishes registry:5000/argocd-hook:<n>' that are code-complete but owed to an operator keystroke).
